crossRefs.note: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?
For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,
The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.
Ephraim feeds on wind, and chases the east wind. He continually multiplies lies and desolation. They make a covenant…
He wanted to fill his belly with the husks that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.
Yahweh said, ‘Who will entice Ahab, that he may go up and fall at Ramoth Gilead?’ One said one thing; and another said…
Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself; for emptiness will be his reward.
My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them…
For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things…
Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are…
Because of this, God sends them a working of error, that they should believe a lie;
If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”
The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole…
He deceives my own people who dwell on the earth because of the signs he was granted to do in front of the beast…
The light of a lamp will shine no more at all in you. The voice of the bridegroom and of the bride will be heard no…
and cast him into the abyss, and shut it, and sealed it over him, that he should deceive the nations no more, until the…

Yahweh, my strength, and my stronghold, and my refuge in the day of affliction, the nations will come to you from the…

even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,
through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,

translations.web: He feeds on ashes. A deceived heart has turned him aside; and he can’t deliver his soul, nor say, “Isn’t there a lie in my right hand?”
translations.bsb: He feeds on ashes. His deluded heart has led him astray, and he cannot deliver himself or say, “Is not this thing in my right hand a lie?”
translations.kjv: He feedeth on ashes: a deceived heart hath turned him aside, that he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?
translations.asv: He feedeth on ashes; a deceived heart hath turned him aside; and he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?
